site_name: Sunbury Lodge, 1 Sunbury Street, Woolwich, London SE18 5NA
description: An application submitted under Section 96a of the Town & Country Planning Act 1990 for a non-material amendment in connection with the planning permission dated 31/03/2016 (Reference: 15/3555/F) for Demolition of the existing care home and redevelopment of the site to provide 48 residential units: 14 x 1-bed, 21 x 2-bed, and 10 x 3-bed flats, and 3 x 2-bed houses incorporating 17 affordable residential units with associated car and cycle parking and landscaping.This amendment seeks the replacement of 38 no. existing patio/balcony doors & windows with new 38 no. aluminium-framed patio/balcony doors and windows within the same structural opening with matching fenestration, orientation and colour (RAL 7016).
